intro: Который is in line with the antecedent in gender and number, but your case depends on your function within the subordinate.

bloques.titulo: Который is in line with the antecedent in gender and number, but your case depends on your function within the subordinate.
texto: Который is in line with the antecedent in gender and number, but your case depends on your function within the subordinate.
Compare книга, которую я прочитал (object) and книга, которая лежит здесь (subject).

frases.ru: Это тема, о которой мы говорили на семинаре.
frases.es: Es el tema sobre el que hablamos en el seminario.
frases.en: This is the subject we spoke about at the seminar.

frases.ru: Я нашёл статью, которую ты советовал.
frases.es: Encontré el artículo que me recomendaste.
frases.en: I found the article you recommended.

bloques.pregunta: What complete form «о проекте, ___ мы говорили»?

opciones.explicacion: После о is used prepositional; проект es masculine: котором.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.
